mapper.select: SELECT GATE_ID AS GATE_ID, NAME_KO AS NAME_KO, DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, SORT_NO AS SORT_NO, ACTIVE_YN AS ACTIVE_YN FROM TB_IF_GATE_DEF_PILOT WHERE NVL(ACTIVE_YN,'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_NO, GATE_ID

SELECT R.RESULT_ID AS RESULT_ID, R.GATE_ID AS GATE_ID, D.NAME_KO AS GATE_NAME, R.TARGET_TYPE_CD AS TARGET_TYPE_CD, R.TARGET_ID AS TARGET_ID, R.RESULT_CD AS RESULT_CD, R.PASS_YN AS PASS_YN, R.EVIDENCE AS EVIDENCE, R.CHECKED_BY AS CHECKED_BY, R.CHECKED_AT AS CHECKED_AT, R.REMARK AS REMARK FROM TB_IF_GATE_RESULT_PILOT R JOIN TB_IF_GATE_DEF_PILOT D ON D.GATE_ID = R.GATE_ID WHERE 1=1 AND R.TARGET_TYPE_CD = #{targetTypeCd} AND R.TARGET_ID = #{targetId} AND R.GATE_ID = #{gateId} ORDER BY D.SORT_NO, R.GATE_ID
SELECT * FROM TB_IF_GATE_RESULT_PILOT WHERE GATE_ID = #{gateId} AND TARGET_TYPE_CD = #{targetTypeCd} AND TARGET_ID = #{targetId}
